notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's terrain.rs is Bevy material/pipeline plumbing (splat ExtendedMaterial, WGSL bindings, per-flag blend/depth specialization for M2/WMO/liquid/WDL). MSUI achieves the observable scene through its own OpenGL pipeline: per-tile ADT splat terrain with height queries, MCLQ liquid with depth fade and submerged tint, foliage, WMO/doodad renderers and WoW-style lighting.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Per-blend-mode byte fidelity (Mod/Mod2x factors, zfill priming, clutter over-blend, WDL horizon band) was not audited item-by-item - those are renderer internals outside this system review's behavioral scope; any visible divergence would surface in dedicated render-parity entries, not here. MSUI's LiquidRenderer deliberately diverges stylistically (Gerstner waves, baked depth fade) from the reference ocean0_s.bls port.
